status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 54% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.

summary.en: Iraq's parliament approved the al-Zaidi cabinet amid growing economic concerns, while the IRGC declared its forces fully prepared on land, sea and air and US sanctions tightened on Iran's economy targeting individuals and entities. Kataib Hezbollah warned it will target hostile aircraft over Iraq, and Iraq explored military technology at a Washington expo and signed a memorandum of understanding with Morocco to develop security training and qualification. Fuad Hussein reported that Iraq suffered $60 billion in losses due to the war with Iran, and the foreign minister discussed enhanced security and military cooperation with his Italian counterpart. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
